name: EVE™ (CRISE Virtual Training)
description: Virtual reality emergency team training simulator for crisis management and CBRN (chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear) response. Supports immersive multi-player training scenarios for emergency responders and crisis management teams, enabling realistic team coordination training in dangerous scenarios without physical risk.
domain: CBRN response, emergency response, crisis management training
reputation: specialized VR training platform used by European emergency response organizations
notes: Commercial VR platform. CBRN focus differentiates from generic crisis simulators. Multi-player VR enables team coordination training. European market focus.
